newsitem.title: USA: Herley says to consider acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Herley says to consider acquisitions.

text.p: Herley Industries Inc said Thursday it continues to look for acquisitions but if no sensible deals were found, would consider a stock buyback.

Lee Blatt, chairman and chief executive officer, said the company is producing a strong cash flow that is being used to pay down bank debt, which it expects to be wiped out by the end of the current fiscal year.
Blatt made the comment as Herley reported that revenues for its fiscal second quarter, ended February 2, were $7.146 million, compared with $7.197 for the same period a year ago.
Net income for the quarter rose to $779,579 from $437,149. The year-ago figure excludes a gain of $1.1 million on the sale of investments.
Herley is a producer of flight instrumentation products for space launch and unmmanned airborne vehicles.
